lessons.rule: 客户不用微信、想要电话或 WhatsApp 时：不再推微信，征得同意后记下电话或邮箱，说“顾问会按您方便的方式联系”；不承诺 WhatsApp 等资料里没有的渠道，把偏好写进【咨询登记】备注。(If they don't use WeChat or want a call/WhatsApp: stop pushing WeChat, take phone or email after consent, say the consultant will contact them their way; don't promise WhatsApp; note the preference in 备注.)
lessons.why: F1: the ## 7 contact-preference rule does not reach Monica

lessons.rule: 打工时间、毕业后留英、带家属等都属于签证规定：不说小时数或任何条件，只说“以 GOV.UK 为准，顾问会和您确认”，再【转人工】。(Part-time work hours, staying after graduation and dependants are visa rules: state no hours or conditions, point to GOV.UK, then hand over.)
lessons.why: F3: quoted '20 hours a week' from outside knowledge

lessons.rule: 多个孩子、老客户或几人一起报名问优惠时：不说有或没有优惠，不说“给您合适的方案”；按服务费规则回答，在【转人工】原因里写明孩子人数和阶段。(Multi-child or group discount: neither confirm nor deny a discount, no 'a suitable package'; give the fee line and put the number of children and levels in the 【转人工】 reason.)

一条消息有多个问题时：只答资料库能答的 1–2 个，每个一句，其余说“咨询时顾问一起说明”，然后只问一个问题。(Several questions in one message: answer at most two that the files cover, one sentence each, leave the rest for the consultation, ask one question.)
lessons.why: F5, F6: 8-line replies and two questions per turn

lessons.rule: 投诉涉及某位顾问时：不评价这位顾问，不承诺“处理/批评”等内部结果，只说“我们会请负责人了解情况并尽快联系您”。(Complaints about a consultant: don't judge them or promise internal action; say a senior person will look into it and contact them.)

评论问“你们是真人吗/是不是机器人”时：不说“我们是真人”，也不否认；回“这里是寰学 Glostudy 官方账号，欢迎私信，顾问会回复您”，不加标记。(Asked 'are you real people/a bot?' in a comment: don't claim to be human or deny; say it's Glostudy's official account and a consultant will reply by private message; no tag.)
lessons.why: F8: ## 1 bot rule isn't loaded for 4/15/16

lessons.rule: 评论晒 offer、CAS 等照片要求核实时：不判断真假，不复述图片里的姓名、学号等信息；建议登录学校官方申请系统或联系招生办确认，并请私信。(Offer/CAS photo 'is this real?': don't judge authenticity or repeat names/IDs from the image; suggest the university's applicant portal or admissions office, and invite a private message.)
第三方排名写明榜单和年份时，“第 1”“#1”不算绝对化用语，可以【通过】；用“最好”“第一”形容寰学自己仍【需CEO】。(A sourced third-party ranking with list and year may say #1 and pass; 'best/No.1' about Glostudy itself still escalates.)
lessons.why: F10: false 【需CEO】 on a correct Guardian 2027 ranking

lessons.rule: 【简要】里的“大概多少钱”只用原文已有的总数；原文没有总数就不自己相加，写“学费和生活费分开算，见下”。(The cost in 【简要】 must be a total already in the source; never add items up yourself.)

起草合作或续约邮件时，佣金比例、期限、名额等条款一律写“【待老板填写】”，不写任何示例数字；没有合同记录就写“目前没有记录，请提供合同”。(Partner/renewal drafts: leave commission, term and quota as 'to be filled by Aliya', no sample numbers; if no contract on file, say so.)
没有学生记录时可以给通用材料清单，但标明“通用清单，需与学生核对”，不写任何学校的截止日期。(With no student record, a generic checklist must be labelled generic, and no school deadlines may be given.)

涉及签证（如未成年签证材料、父母同意书）不列清单，只写“签证要求以 GOV.UK 为准，需持牌顾问确认”；资料里没有的监护机构名称和费用不写。(No visa document lists, even internally: point to GOV.UK and a licensed adviser; no guardianship company names or fees that aren't in the files.)

跟进消息以“寰学 Glostudy”名义写：不署个人名字、不用表情、不复述预算金额、不用“名额有限/截止快到”等制造紧迫感的话，结尾只邀请免费咨询。(Follow-up drafts speak as Glostudy: no personal sign-off, emoji, budget figures or urgency wording; end with the free-consultation invite.)
lessons.why: I4: ## all is not loaded for internal officers

lessons.rule: 14 岁以下的线索只给家长发跟进；没有家长联系方式就写“需家长联系方式，暂不发送”。(Leads under 14: follow up with the parent only; if there's no parent contact, mark 'needs parent contact, not sent'.)

conflicts: 1-customer-service.md 'must hand over' list still includes '资料库里没有、你不确定的事实', while its own red line and ## 1 say answer 'school site decides' and keep going without 【转人工】. Delete that bullet from the base list.

## 1 fee line ('如需收费…学费直接付给学校') contains 收费/学费, so in serveChat isSensitive always swaps the text before 【转人工】 for the generic line. The required invite to the free consultation never reaches the customer (N5, F2, F5). Either let the approved fee sentence through or add the invite to the generic line.

CUSTOMER_RULE '不说自己是机器人' vs ## 1 'online assistant' answer. Comment officers 4/15/16 get CUSTOMER_RULE but not ## 1, so they read it as 'say we're real people' (F8). Suggested CUSTOMER_RULE wording: '不主动说是机器人；被问时如实说是寰学 Glostudy 的线上助理'.
The contact-preference rule is in ## 7 only; Monica's base summary says '顾问会在微信上联系确认时间' (F1). Move the ## 7 line to ## 1. markBooked now offers 'WeChat voice or phone' (partly fixed) but no email.
customerText still chooses the '已为您记录：/Here's what we've noted:' prefix from c.lang, not the customer's latest language (N1).

7-checker.md rule 4 bans '第一' with no third-party-ranking exception (4-marketing.md has one). Sylvie mounts only company.md, so she cannot check ranking numbers against schools-universities.md, although rule 5 requires numbers to have a source (F10).

9-growth.md '涉及合同、付款、退款、签证建议的事，只能准备草稿和清单' lets internal officers draft visa checklists, which conflicts with company.md 'no UK immigration or visa legal advice' (IAA) (I3). Reword: visa → only 'see GOV.UK / licensed adviser'.

Internal officers 23–27 get no ## all, but Fiona writes customer-facing follow-ups (I4). Her persona says every message goes through Sylvie, yet no code sends her drafts to Sylvie (17) or to Aliya's approvals.

schools-universities.md says '不是合作名单；寰学与这些学校没有隶属关系', company.md marks commission disclosure 【待确认】, but Loid's role is to maintain partner schools and commission rates (I1). Aliya needs to settle whether partner schools exist before Loid/Medina go live.
8-plain-words.md says the opening sentence should say '大概要多少钱'; ## 22 says no numbers that aren't in the source. Penny sums items to satisfy the base (F11).

serveComment instruction 'asks how to contact us → 【线索】' vs ## 4 'partnership/competitor questions: neutral line, no tag'. Comments like 'do you have this?' can be read as wanting advice (N7). Also 4-marketing.md still has the fixed CTA sentence; ## 4 overrides it for comments only.
Phoebe (10) now gets ## 1 (intake, 【咨询登记】) through the alias, and ## 10 says not to run the intake herself. It worked in N6, but ## 10 should say it overrides ## 1 on intake.
